messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "stopping beta blocker abruptly can bring on worse chest pain"
set: ["stopping beta blocker abruptly can bring on worse chest pain", "stopping beta blocker abruptly can bring on a heart attack", "stopping abruptly can cause uncontrolled pain", "stopping abruptly can cause serious withdrawal symptoms", "stopping suddenly may cause chest pain or heart attack", "stopping suddenly can trigger thyroid crisis", "blood pressure can rise sharply if not started with alpha blocker", "can make brain function worse in people with cirrhosis", "heart failure can get worse while dose is being increased", "stopping suddenly can increase risk of blood clot or stroke", "adverse reactions likely when stopped abruptly", "symptoms especially reported when stopped abruptly", "new or worse depression or anxiety", "stopping may not be safe", "stopping treatment is not automatically safer", "symptoms go away after stopping medication"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
